test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average age of the boys in the class was 16 years. When 4 boys whose average age was 13 years are admitted to the class, the average age of the class was reduced by 6 months. How many boys were there initially in the class?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial average age of boys = 16 years.

Average age of 4 new boys = 13 years.

New average age of class = 16 - 0.5 = 15.5 years.

**Formula Used:**

New average = (Total age of all members) / (Total number of members)

Initial total age of boys = Initial average age × Number of boys

New total age of boys = New average age × N
